upgrades.changelog:
* Includes firmware versions: 4.0, 4.10, 4.20, 4.30
* Updated SDK from 7.22.1 to 7.23.1
* Fixed startup status reporting issues: 1-Endpoint 0 was not reporting its status after startup. 2-Endpoint 1 could generate duplicate status reports.
* Optimized the status reporting delay for single-channel devices when operated from the main toggle (Endpoint 0).
* Prevented redundant Endpoint 0 status reports triggered by Supervision commands.
* Ensured that all controllable endpoints report their status correctly after any operation.

* Includes firmware versions: 4.0, 4.10, 4.20
* Fixed a bug: Reports from Meter Command Class might be affected on the selected platforms.
* Fixed a bug: Parameter 37, the software was reporting incorrect units for Current threshold.
* The current and power acquisition algorithm has been optimized to reduce the intermediate reporting data.
* Improved meter reporting when a value changes from non-zero (last reported value) to zero (current value).
